paragraphs.text:
Silently, you motion Norman and Sylvia to stay back and get 
under cover. You observe the group for a moment, assessing 
their behavior.

One goes behind a nearby tree and yanks a girl to her feet. 
She looks like she belongs to their community, but her hands 
are bound. Puzzled by this rough treatment of one of their own, 
you watch the Tsuut’ina lash her to a tree trunk with rawhide 
thongs. When they are done, they gather their gear and depart 
from the hollow.

To shout after them, go to 560. To let them move off before you 
approach the girl, go to 577.
